department: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences

requirements.name: Area I Core
requirements.note: Admission to the major is contingent upon fulfilling the following requirements: At least a 2.7 University of California grade-point average in Area I At least a 2.0 University of California grade-point average in Area II All courses must be completed on a letter-grade basis No course with a grade lower than C- in Area I & II Not more than one course with a C- in Area I & II Students must submit a “Petition to Change Major” to the departmental main office (1814 Psychology East) for admission to the pre-major and major. Note: Students must complete PSY 1, MATH 34A (or 2A or 3A), PSTAT 5ALS or equivalent, and CHEM 1A-B (or 2A-B) prior to enrolling in PSY 10A; PSY 10A is a prerequisite for PSY 10B.
requirements.note_zh: 准入门槛：领域 I 的 UC GPA ≥ 2.7、领域 II ≥ 2.0；全部课程须以字母成绩修读；领域 I、II 中低于 C- 的课不接受，且 C- 最多只能有一门。须向系办公室（1814 Psychology East）提交「Petition to Change Major」申请进入预备与正式专业。修 PSY 10A 前须先完成 PSY 1、MATH 34A（或 2A 或 3A）、PSTAT 5ALS 或等效课、CHEM 1A-B（或 2A-B）；PSY 10A 是 PSY 10B 的先修。

requirements.name: Area D
requirements.note: 16 additional units chosen from a combination of the following MAJOR REGULATIONS PREREQUISITES Check the General Catalog for the prerequisites to all listed courses. P/NP GRADING OPTION Up to 8 units of PSY 199P may be taken for major credit. All other major courses (Pre, Prep, or UD), including courses applied to the major from other departments, must be completed on a letter-grade basis. SUBSTITUTIONS In the major requirements permissible only by petition to the department chair and dean. G.P.A. REQUIREMENTS At least 2.0 overall UC average in all upper-division major courses and all courses (Prep and UD) for the major. DOUBLE MAJORS With the approval of each department chairperson, up to a total of 8 units may be applied simultaneously to both UD majors.
requirements.note_zh: 从下列组合另选 16 学分。PSY 199P 最多 8 学分可按 P/NP 计入专业，其余专业课（预备/高年级，含他系计入的课）必须以字母成绩修读；替换须经 petition 批准；高年级及全部专业课 UC 平均 ≥ 2.0；双专业最多 8 学分可双计。
